newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China builds country's biggest smart card plant.
newsitem.headline: China builds country's biggest smart card plant.

text.p: China has set up its largest "smart card" factory in the southern boomtown of Shenzhen with German company Orga, the Shenzhen-based Financial Morning Post said on Friday.

The Shenzhen Orga Smart Card System Co, a Sino-German joint venture involving several Shenzhen-based companies, will make smart cards which have integrated circuit chips and which store information pertinent to banks accounts, identification and mobile phones, the newspaper said.
It did not reveal the venture's registered capital or give a breakdown of each shareholder's stake.
Company officials were not available for comment.
It said Shenzhen Orga would produce 20 million cards per year from May 1997, using 20 million yuan for first-phase construction.
The venture would pump in another 140 million yuan to lift annual production capacity to 80 million cards in 1998, when output value is expected to hit 1.2 billion yuan, the paper said.
